subject: general
question: How many member countries did the UNO have on its formation in 1945?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 51**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When the UN was established in 1945, **just 51 countries were 'member states'**.
 
• This count grew steadily as more countries gained independence - **with help from the UN** and today the **UN has 193 member states.**
 
• The member states finance the **UN's activities and rule its programme of work.**
 
• According to the UN Yearbook, 1946-1947, **China** was the first to sign the UN Charter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The United Nations (U.N.), headquartered in New York, is **an international organization of 193 member-states and was founded in 1945 to prevent another world war**.
 
• The U.N. is **not a government, nor can it pass binding laws**, but between **persuasion, negotiates multilateral agreements to assist form international law. **
 
• In inclusion to keep international peace and security, the United Nations **protects human rights, delivers humanitarian aid, promotes sustainable development and upholds international law**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6848a7315717e3326bf654953a15cd7ccf022c89b48e9b417f6207f3a8fed4e.png]
